exposure: Type and duration of epileptic seizure
Date of last seizure prior to pregnancy
Number and duration of seizures during pregnancy
outcome: Result and week of termination of pregnancy
Fetal malformations (cleft lip and palate, ventriculoseptal defect, spina bifida)
cohort: The study included 149 epileptic pregnant women evaluated between March 2009 and January 2015 at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Epileptic seizures occurred in 69.12% of patients during pregnancy, with a notable observation of major fetal malformations including cleft lip and palate, ventriculoseptal defect, and spina bifida.
